name: Southern Africa floods
headline: Repeated heavy rain systems; a year's rain in days in places.
numbers: About 300 in the wider region (OCHA flash update, 27 Jan)

sections.The setup: Weak La Niña and warm seas.
sections.The trigger: Repeated heavy rain systems; a year's rain in days in places.
sections.What amplified it: Moisture-rich air; rivers burst, Kruger closed.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
